text:
I don't know for sure, but I suppose

that a woman and a man

someday love each other,

grow lonely little by little,

something in their hearts tells them they are alone,

alone on earth they enter each other,

they slowly kill each other.


Everything happens in silence. As

light happens inside the eye.

Love brings bodies together.

In silence they fill each other little by little.


One day they awaken, lying on arms;

then they think they know everything.

They see each other naked and they know everything.


(I don't know for sure. I suppose.)

translation.title: I Don't Know for Sure
